feature.title: Dama x Elat
feature.copy: The founder of Elat reached out on 19 January 2026 with a proposal to collaborate on bringing Elat’s knowledge and passion for astrology back to Damascus and Syria at large. The collaboration focuses on raising awareness of Damascus’s long history of astronomical knowledge, including the prominent scientists who lived in or originated from the city, while exploring the deep-rooted fascination with the cosmos within Syrian culture.

feature.title: Bring The Money You Owe
feature.copy: A member of the campaign team reached out on 18 May 2026 to explore a collaboration around the Bring The Money You Owe campaign. The collaboration culminated in an event on 22 July, bringing together people who believe in and support the campaign. All sales from the collaboration went toward funding the campaign. A copy of the campaign can be requested through Stunning Studio.
